description:
Commit the listed files on the current branch. Nothing is pushed.
                        - files is required: only those paths are committed (no "add all"); other staged changes are left out
                        - refused on main or master (create a branch first), on a detached HEAD, for paths outside the repository,
                          and for paths protected by .remotepilot.json ("protectedPaths")
                        - no --amend, no rebase, no hook skipping

                        This command can be referenced as "DC: ..." or "use RemotePilot to ..." in your instructions.
name: git_commit
